# Curved Lianjia reconstruction review

`draft.json` is a provider-neutral `plan2world-draft-v1` semantic white model with 1 floor, 85 walls, 21 doors/openings, 12 windows, and 27 independent semantic furniture/fixture blocks. No room polygons are supplied. `first-pass.json` was saved before running the checker and remains unchanged.

Scale uses the legible bottom 3430 mm dimension between approximately x=655 and x=817: **2.1172839506 cm/pixel**, uniformly in both axes. World origin corresponds to source pixel (269,81). The original raster is **1536 × 1152**. Tick reading is approximate; other printed chains have small inconsistencies, so scale confidence is 0.81. Six spread-out wall endpoints provide registration.

The actual local raster, enlarged upper/lower crops, and complete wall/opening/furniture overlays were inspected. Curved frontage and lower perimeter use quadratic controls, not faceted approximations. The source's white exterior notch remains empty. Doors and windows interrupt continuous host walls. The final visual review enlarged the small Bath A west door from the first-pass estimate of 25 px to approximately 30 px and shifted its centre by 2 px; the final width is 29.5 px to keep a positive wall-end margin.

The repository CLI was run on both first pass and final draft, with reports in `inspection/first-pass/` and `inspection/final/`. Both runs exited successfully: **0 geometry errors, 3 warnings, registration accepted**. The warnings are a 23.3 cm balcony A jog and two detached solid foyer arcs, retained because they correspond to the source. Conversion produced 18 derived native room faces and preserved all 27 furniture blocks; that count is not a claim that the source has 18 rooms. An additional arithmetic audit checked unique IDs, finite/positive values, host references, opening ranges and arc-length containment. Minimum opening endpoint margin is 0.529289 cm; maximum anchor transform residual is below 0.000001 source pixel.

Remaining uncertainties: the free-standing foyer arcs may be screens/railings rather than full-height walls; Bath C's fragmented interior line is treated as a wet-area screen and omitted; curved controls are hand fits that can deviate by several source pixels. Dashed outer balcony B/C limits are omitted from walls, so their balcony floors may not be derived. Heights, ordinary door presentation, furniture styles and floor-to-ceiling glazing are editable assumptions. No unseen cabinetry/sinks or decorative rug geometry was invented. No editor/browser or 3D walkthrough was performed. Structural validity and consistent registration do **not** certify source-image accuracy.
